items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Me and Bassy were staying together. He was a big guy... I met a piano player up there who was looking for a trumpet player... I went over to St. Paul to work for him

ctx.x: That was a long time ago, before he had his family... Anyway, to get back to... So here you were up in Fargo, doing this.
Yeah. So pretty soon that job run out. And we said, "Where should we go from here, Bassy and I?" I said, "Well, let's go to Minneapolis.
